title: Deceptive fairy gentry in medieval folklore

tellings.quote: the peasants know that these beings lie all the time.

plain: A philosopher named Jason Jorjani, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels, describes old country folklore from Brittany in France and from Ireland about the fairy folk, sometimes called the gentry. Drawing on the work of Jacques Vallee, a researcher who compared such folklore with modern UFO stories, Jorjani says the peasants knew these beings lie all the time. The point, as he tells it, is that whatever people meet in such encounters may not be telling the truth about itself.
